entry.title: FSA posts agenda for third meeting of Business Accounting Council's sustainability assurance subcommittee on third-party assurance standards
entry.summary: 企業会計審議会第３回サステナビリティ情報保証部会の議事次第について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency published the agenda and materials for the third meeting of the Business Accounting Council's Sustainability Information Assurance Subcommittee, scheduled for October 29, 2026. The secretariat's briefing material is a draft opinion on standards for assurance services, quality management, and ethics and independence for sustainability information. It explains the background, the purpose of third-party assurance, and the proposed nature and names of the standards.

entry.title: Notice of a symposium co-hosted by the FSA and Hitotsubashi University (December 10, 2026)
entry.summary: 金融庁・一橋大学による共催シンポジウムの開催について（令和８年12月10日）公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 28, 2026 The Financial Services Agency and Hitotsubashi University will co-host a symposium on December 10, 2026, at Hitotsubashi Hall in Tokyo. Themes are regional economic revitalization and finance, and corporate value enhancement and Japanese corporate management. The program includes FSA presentations, practitioner lectures, and a panel discussion with university researchers, open to the public by advance registration and conducted in Japanese.

entry.title: Basel Committee publishes AML/CFT supervisory newsletter

entry.title: FSA announces registration of Kroll Bond Rating Agency Japan as a credit rating agency

The registration was made under Article 57(3) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act, as applied by Article 66-48.

entry.title: Summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference (October 23, 2026)
entry.summary: 記者会見,片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要（令和８年10月23日）について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Oct 27, 2026 The Financial Services Agency published a summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference on October 23, 2026. He discussed financial institutions preventively suspending systems in response to a PHP vulnerability and said the response served as useful preparation. He also said no decision had been made on extending winter electricity and gas subsidies or gasoline subsidies, and that the content-industry budget would reflect lessons from the Cool Japan Fund's failures.

entry.title: Summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-Cabinet press conference (October 20, 2026)
entry.summary: 記者会見,片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要（令和８年10月20日）について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Oct 27, 2026 This is a summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-Cabinet press conference on October 20, 2026. Topics include financial damage prevention after corporate personal data leaks, reports of a corporate tax increase to fund defense buildup, Diet deliberations on the consumption tax and support fee bill, and the TOPIX index constituent revision.

entry.title: Summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference (October 16, 2026)
entry.summary: 記者会見,片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要（令和８年10月16日）について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Oct 27, 2026 At the October 16, 2026 press conference, Finance Minister Katayama discussed the outcomes of the G20 and G7 finance ministers' and central bank governors' meetings in Bangkok, including supply chain resilience, AI risks, and global imbalances. He also covered bilateral meetings with Korea, India, Thailand and Indonesia. On a supplementary budget, he said its necessity cannot yet be predicted, and any such budget would be limited to highly urgent measures under the 2026 basic policy.

entry.title: Notice on agenda and materials for the Multiple Debt Problem Countermeasures Promotion Advisory Panel
entry.summary: 多重債務問題対策推進懇談会の議事次第等について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 27, 2026 · Crypto On October 27, 2026, the Financial Services Agency published the agenda and related materials for the Multiple Debt Problem Countermeasures Promotion Advisory Panel. The meeting is scheduled for October 28, 2026 from 14:00 to 15:45 and will discuss the current situation and policy trends for measures against multiple debtors, followed by an exchange of views. The documents include the meeting purpose, member list, operating rules, and related statistics.

entry.title: FSA recruits a lawyer-qualified staff member for domestic financial policy work
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（国内金融に関する制度の企画及び立案等の業務に従事する職員） 金融庁 · Oct 26, 2026 The Financial Services Agency is recruiting one section-chief-assistant level staff member to plan and draft domestic financial system rules and handle related work. Applicants must hold a lawyer qualification plus broad knowledge of financial laws or relevant experience. The post is a fixed-term regular national civil service position, generally for one to two years, with applications due November 9, 2026 (must arrive by then).

entry.title: FSA Recruits Staff for International Affairs Work (Deputy Section Chief Level)
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（国際関連業務に従事する職員） 金融庁 · Oct 26, 2026 The Financial Services Agency (FSA) of Japan is recruiting a full-time staff member at deputy section chief level for international-related duties. The fixed-term position is generally for about two years, based at the FSA in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. Duties include research on international financial regulation, markets and corporate governance, as well as participation in international meetings and coordination with foreign authorities. Selection is based on document screening followed by interviews.

entry.title: FSA recruits staff for international affairs (assistant director level)
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（国際関連業務に従事する職員） 金融庁 · Oct 26, 2026 The Financial Services Agency (Japan) is recruiting a fixed-term civil servant for international work on insurance regulation and supervision. The role involves negotiations with foreign authorities and international bodies such as the IAIS, based in Chiyoda, Tokyo, for about two years. Candidates need financial sector experience and strong English; selection is by document screening followed by an interview.

entry.title: Summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference (October 13, 2026): named next chair of the joint World Bank-IMF Development Committee
entry.summary: 記者会見,片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要（令和８年10月13日）について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Oct 26, 2026 Finance Minister Katayama announced he has been named the next chair of the joint World Bank-IMF Development Committee, for a two-year term through October 2028. It would be the first time a Japanese finance minister has chaired the committee since its 1974 founding. In the Q&A, he discussed reviewing tax measures, subsidies and funds, and price-relief spending in supplementary budgets, but said no specific amounts had been determined.

entry.title: Summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference on October 9, 2026
entry.summary: 記者会見,片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要（令和８年10月９日）について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Oct 26, 2026 This is a summary of Japan's Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference. It reports the cabinet approval of a consumption tax and support payment bill, which would temporarily cut the consumption tax rate on food for two years from April 2027 and introduce an employee burden-relief support payment. It also covers a review of tax special measures, subsidies and funds, a call for financial institutions to strengthen identity verification and cybersecurity, and a fund to support recovery from the Kumamoto earthquake.

entry.title: Announcement of the 2026 High-Level Meeting of the Asia GX Consortium (FSA Japan)
entry.summary: 「アジアGXコンソーシアム」ハイレベル会合2026の開催について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 23, 2026 The Financial Services Agency of Japan announced that the Third High-Level Meeting of the Asia GX Consortium (AGXC) was held in Manila, the Philippines, on October 23, 2026, with ASEAN financial authorities, the Asian Development Bank, and regional financial institutions attending. The meeting presented the AGXC 2026 Annual Report and the ASEAN Transition Plan Handbook, developed by ADB with AGXC, and discussed future directions for transition finance in ASEAN. The annual report is attached, while the handbook will be published separately by ADB.

entry.title: Notice of the 2nd meeting of the Financial System Council's Insurance System Working Group
entry.summary: 金融審議会「保険制度ワーキング・グループ」（第２回）の開催について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 23, 2026 The Financial Services Agency announced that the 2nd meeting of the Financial System Council's Insurance System Working Group will be held on October 30, 2026, from 15:00 to 17:30, at a venue in Central Government Building No. 7 with online participation. The agenda includes secretariat briefings, a hearing, and discussion. No general public gallery seats are available; the meeting will be streamed on YouTube, and minutes will be published on the FSA website afterward.

entry.title: Financial Services Agency recruiting staff for financial monitoring (market and liquidity risk management)
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（金融モニタリング業務(市場リスク管理及び流動性リスク管理)に従事する職員） 金融庁 · Oct 23, 2026 The Financial Services Agency is recruiting one staff member to monitor market and liquidity risk management at deposit-taking financial institutions. entry.title: FSA updates list of NISA tsumitate-investment-frame eligible products and overview
entry.summary: その他,つみたて投資枠対象商品届出一覧及びつみたて投資枠対象商品の概要を更新しました。 金融庁 · Oct 23, 2026 On October 23, 2026, the Financial Services Agency updated its list of notified tsumitate-investment-frame eligible products, sorted by fund manager and by underlying asset, along with an overview of those products. entry.title: Update on Names of Persons Conducting Financial Instruments Business Without Registration (FSA Japan)
entry.summary: その他,無登録で金融商品取引業を行う者の名称等について更新しました。 金融庁 · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency (through Finance Bureaus) updated its list of persons who conduct financial instruments business without registration and were issued warning letters, as of October 23, 2026. The list covers domestic and overseas businesses, showing trade names, locations, business content, notes, and publication dates. The FSA notes that listed entities were confirmed as unregistered at the time of the warning, may not reflect current activity, and names or addresses may be outdated. Concerned individuals may contact the FSA consultation desk or the SESC information desk.

The Japan IR Council presented survey results on IR activities and overseas corporate disclosure examples.

Applicants need asset management work experience and knowledge of financial laws; English-language ability is preferred.

entry.title: Announcement of the Financial Economic Education Event “Learn with Wanisa: Money Class for the Future in Hiroshima”

The meeting included reports from relevant ministries and agencies. The excerpt describes the current state of on-chain finance, including asset tokenization, stablecoins, and tokenized deposits. Public comments are invited, with a deadline of 17:00 on November 16, 2026 (must arrive by that time).

entry.title: Survey results on accessibility measures for people with disabilities at insurers (as of end-March 2026)
entry.summary: 保険会社等における障がい者等に配慮した取組に関するアンケート調査の結果について（令和８年３月末時点）の公表 金融庁 · Oct 16, 2026 The Financial Services Agency published the results of a survey on measures taken by insurance companies and small-amount short-term insurers for persons with disabilities, as of the end of March 2026. The results cover internal rules for proxy writing and reading, support for hearing-impaired customers, Braille and relay services. Firms are encouraged to continue improving convenience.

entry.title: Publication of Status of Responses to Unauthorized Remittance Issues for Deposits (as of End of March 2026)
entry.summary: 預貯金の不正送金問題等に対する対応状況（令和８年３月末）の公表 金融庁 · Oct 16, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency surveyed deposit-taking financial institutions on their status regarding authentication methods for ATMs and internet banking as of the end of March 2026, and published a summary of the results. The survey was voluntary and based on preliminary figures, which may be revised after verification.

entry.title: Japan FSA and MLIT ask general insurance association to properly run trust-recovery measures for the sector
entry.summary: 損害保険業界の信頼回復に向けた取組の適切な運用の公表 金融庁 · Oct 13, 2026 On October 13, 2026, the Financial Services Agency and the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism jointly asked the Japan General Insurance Association to operate its agency quality evaluation system as intended. The request calls for dialogue tailored to each agency's size and business characteristics, and warns against uniform deadlines or one-size-fits-all responses. The document sets out seven measures for insurers, including avoiding a reduction in agencies that could limit access to compulsory auto liability insurance.

entry.title: Public notice of partial amendment to the notice designating financial institutions under Article 17 of the Act on Management of Deposit Accounts Using Individual Numbers at the Depositor's Intent
entry.summary: 「預貯金者の意思に基づく個人番号の利用による預貯金口座の管理等に関する法律第十七条の規定に基づき金融機関を定める件」の一部改正の公表 金融庁 · Oct 13, 2026 The Financial Services Agency announced a partial amendment to the notice designating financial institutions under Article 17 of the Act on Management of Deposit Accounts Using Individual Numbers at the Depositor's Intent, effective October 13, 2026. The amendment adds Mitsubishi UFJ Emmott Bank, Ltd. to the list and deletes the Amakusa Fisheries Cooperative entry. Public comment procedures were not conducted because the notice does not fall under the orders covered by the Administrative Procedure Act.

entry.title: Opening of Kumamoto Industrial Recovery Consultation Center and Establishment of Kumamoto Earthquake 2026 Recovery Support Fund
entry.summary: 「熊本産業復興相談センター」の開設及び「令和８年熊本地震復興支援ファンド」の設立について（令和８年熊本地震による被災事業者の多重債務問題対応）の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 The Kumamoto Industrial Recovery Consultation Center opened on October 9, 2026 at the Kumamoto Chamber of Commerce and Industry to provide consultations, including working capital support, to businesses affected by the 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake. The Organization for Small & Medium Enterprises and Regional Economy Revitalization Corporation of Japan (REVIC), together with regional financial institutions, are establishing a fund of up to 5 billion yen to address multiple-debt problems faced by affected businesses.

entry.title: Update to the special page on information related to the 2024 Noto Peninsula Earthquake (as of 10:00, October 9, 2026)
entry.summary: 令和６年能登半島地震関連情報に関する特設ページの更新（令和８年10月９日 10時00分時点） 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 Japan's Financial Services Agency has updated its special page on the 2024 Noto Peninsula Earthquake. It compiles information on financial institutions' operating status in affected areas, support schemes such as debt restructuring for housing loans, insurance inquiry services, donation transfer fees, and fraud warnings. The page also lists the operating status of bank branches and ATMs in the Noto area of Ishikawa Prefecture.

entry.title: Japan FSA Alert on Strengthened Cybersecurity Measures and Handling of Transaction Applications
entry.summary: 現下の情勢を踏まえたサイバーセキュリティ対策の強化と各種取引申込等における対応の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 On October 9, 2026, Japan's Financial Services Agency issued an alert to financial institutions after unauthorized access incidents led to leaks of customer information, including images of driver's licenses and other identity documents. It asks institutions to review cybersecurity measures, including third-party risk management and incident response, and to carefully check document and facial images in non-face-to-face identity verification. It also urges prompt action toward the April 1, 2027 amendment that will generally limit identity verification to reading IC chip information.

entry.title: FSA administrative sanctions on Prudential Life, Gibraltar Life and Prudential Holdings of Japan
entry.summary: プルデンシャル生命保険株式会社、ジブラルタ生命保険株式会社及びプルデンシャル・ホールディング・オブ・ジャパン株式会社に対する行政処分の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 On October 9, 2026, Japan's Financial Services Agency announced administrative sanctions against Prudential Life Insurance, Gibraltar Life Insurance and Prudential Holdings of Japan under the Insurance Business Act. The orders suspend insurance solicitation and contract signing from October 13, 2026 to January 31, 2027, and require business improvement, including sales-force management reforms and an improvement plan with periodic progress reports.

entry.title: Agenda of the 14th Transition Finance Environment Development Study Group
entry.summary: 「トランジション・ファイナンス環境整備検討会」（第14回）議事次第の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 This is the agenda published by the Financial Services Agency for the 14th meeting of the Transition Finance Environment Development Study Group, held on August 21, 2026. Topics include domestic and international trends in transition finance and a draft revision of the basic guidelines for Climate Transition Finance, which is not public. The page also lists members and the organizers (FSA, METI, Ministry of the Environment).

entry.title: Minutes of the 14th Transition Finance Environment Development Study Group Meeting
entry.summary: 「トランジション・ファイナンス環境整備検討会」（第14回）議事要旨の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 The Financial Services Agency of Japan published the minutes of the 14th meeting of the Transition Finance Environment Development Study Group, held on August 21, 2026. The meeting discussed domestic and international trends in transition finance and a revision of the Climate Transition Finance Basic Guidelines, which was not made public. Members commented on developments related to the SFDR, the role of the transition finance subsidy program, and trends in ASEAN.

entry.title: Warning about unauthorized access and trades on online brokerage services
entry.summary: 「インターネット取引サービスへの不正アクセス・不正取引にご注意ください」のページの更新 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 The Financial Services Agency updated its warning page on unauthorized access and unauthorized trading in online brokerage services. Criminals use phishing sites imitating securities firms to steal customer login credentials, then sell stocks in victims' accounts and buy small-cap shares. The page lists monthly provisional figures on incidents and offers prevention tips and FSA consultation contact details.

entry.title: Announcement of the 25th Financial Services Agency–Bank of Japan Liaison Meeting
entry.summary: 第25回「金融庁・日本銀行連絡会」の開催の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 The Financial Services Agency and the Bank of Japan announced they held the 25th FSA–BOJ Liaison Meeting to exchange views on conditions in financial systems and financial markets. Members included the FSA Commissioner and the BOJ Deputy Governor.

entry.title: Status of Financial Revitalization Act disclosed claims as of March 2026
entry.summary: 令和８年３月期における金融再生法開示債権の状況等（ポイント）の公表 金融庁 · Oct 8, 2026 The Financial Services Agency published key points on the status of disclosed claims under the Financial Revitalization Act for the fiscal year ending March 2026, covering Japan's domestic banks. Total disclosed claims were 8.4 trillion yen, roughly flat year on year. Individual allowances for loan losses fell to 1.9 trillion yen, while losses from disposal of nonperforming claims rose to 0.5 trillion yen.

entry.title: Agenda published for the 2nd meeting of the Financial System Council’s working group on funding for growth companies
entry.summary: 金融審議会「成長企業への資金供給の在り方等に関するワーキング・グループ」（第２回）議事次第の公表 金融庁 · Oct 8, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency published the agenda and materials for the second meeting of the Financial System Council working group on funding for growth companies, held on October 9, 2026. The meeting included presentations from the Japan Private Equity Association, the FSA secretariat and the Fintech Association, along with an opinion paper from a member. The materials focus on loosening rules for “professional” lending to large companies engaged in business restructuring.

entry.title: Minutes of 1st Meeting of FSA Working Group on Growth Enterprise Financing Published
entry.summary: 金融審議会「成長企業への資金供給の在り方等に関するワーキング・グループ」（第１回）議事録の公表 金融庁 · Oct 7, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency published the minutes of the first meeting of the Financial System Council's Working Group on Financing for Growth Enterprises, held on September 16, 2026. The meeting covered diversifying funding providers and restructuring money lending regulations for business loans. The Japanese Bankers Association and the Institute of International Bankers also presented.

entry.title: Public notice of names of unregistered crypto-asset exchange operators
entry.summary: 無登録で暗号資産交換業を行う者の名称等の公表 金融庁 · Oct 7, 2026 · Crypto Japan's Financial Services Agency published a list of domestic and overseas operators that conducted crypto-asset exchange business without registration and were issued warning letters, including their names, locations, business details and posting dates. The list reflects status at the time of the warning and may not show current operations or addresses, and unlisted operators may also be unregistered. Users are advised to confirm that an exchange is registered with the FSA or a Local Finance Bureau before using it.

entry.title: Minutes of the 57th Financial System Council General Meeting and 45th Financial Subcommittee Joint Meeting
entry.summary: 第57回金融審議会総会・第45回金融分科会合同会合議事録 金融庁 · Oct 5, 2026 · Crypto Minutes of the joint meeting held on August 31, 2026, published by the Financial Services Agency. Financial Minister Satsuki Katayama referred two questions to the Financial System Council: how to supply funds to growth companies, including flexible regulation of business lending, and the structure of insurance systems, including creating a reinsurance captive scheme and life insurance safety-net arrangements. Secretariat staff explained each item.

entry.title: Notice on the Cross-Industry Financial Cybersecurity Exercise (Delta Wall 2026)
entry.summary: 「金融業界横断的なサイバーセキュリティ演習 （Delta Wall 2026）」の実施の公表 金融庁 · Oct 5, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency will hold the 11th cross-industry cybersecurity exercise, Delta Wall 2026, from October 6 to 22, 2026, with 181 financial institutions expected to take part. The exercise aims to strengthen cyber resilience and incident response across the financial sector, including response readiness when core systems are attacked. Results will be shared with the wider industry beyond the participating institutions.

entry.title: Notice on extension of residence periods due to the 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake
entry.summary: 令和８年熊本地震に伴う在留期間の延長の公表 金融庁 · Oct 5, 2026 The Financial Services Agency announced that, following the 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake, residence periods for eligible foreign nationals in disaster-affected areas were uniformly extended to January 27, 2027 under a Ministry of Justice notice. Because residence cards still show the earlier expiry dates, concerns arose that bank accounts might be closed. The FSA asked industry associations to inform financial institutions of this extension.

entry.title: Financial Services Agency personnel changes (senior staff list updated as of September 30, 2026)
entry.summary: 人事異動（令和８年９月30日付幹部名簿の更新） 金融庁 · Oct 2, 2026 · Crypto This Financial Services Agency notice reports personnel changes and attaches the FSA senior staff directory as of September 30, Reiwa 8 (2026). It lists titles and names for the minister, vice minister, parliamentary officials, and staff at the FSA, the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission, and the Certified Public Accountants and Auditing Oversight Board. The text consists mainly of appointment dates and position lists and contains no policy content or conclusions.
